arStrings.szText: {c_important}Heartseeker{/c} now has a {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%|]{/c} chance to fire an additional arrow. When {c_important}Heartseeker{/c} Critically Strikes, it grants {c_number}{SF_42}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Heartseeker{/c} now pierces up to {c_number}[SF_31]{/c} additional time and deals {c_number}[SF_36 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage against the enemy it hits for the next {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADEB_DAMAGE_BONUS}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[SF_36 * SF_38 * 100|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Heartseeker{/c} now has a {if:SF_45}{c_number}{Cooldown Time}{/c}{else}{c_number}{SF_44}{/c}{/if} second Cooldown and fires {c_number}2{/c} additional arrows to your left and right dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_UPGRADE_C}{/c} damage. If at least {c_number}2{/c} arrows hit the same enemy, surrounding enemies will be Pulled In.

When {c_important}Heartseeker{/c} hits an enemy, your Critical Strike Chance against them is increased by {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|%+|]{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:AMPLIFY_CRIT_CHANCE}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_9}*{SF_10}*100|%+|]{/c}.
Gain {c_number}{SF_39}{/c} Energy when {c_important}Heartseeker{/c} hits an enemy.
When {c_important}Heartseeker{/c} hits an enemy, they become {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_41}{/c} seconds.
